ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
benefits_summary: Deposit-free LPG connection with financial support of ₹1,600, plus a free first LPG cylinder refill and hotplate stove, and ₹300 per cylinder targeted subsidy.
exclusions: Households that already have an existing LPG connection
documents_required: BPL Ration Card or Self-Declaration for Migrant Households
application_steps: Apply online at pmuy.gov.in or visit the nearest LPG distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, HP Gas).
Submit the KYC form along with Ration Card/Deprivation Declaration.
Collect your LPG stove and cylinder after connection release.
